description:
Get one website, app, agent, or skill by name. The result carries the fields every kind has, then a section for its kind. A website: access mode, how many people it is shared with, and attached connectors. An app: each process type with its scale and current state, attached resources with their state, environment variable names, the active release, and how many people it is shared with. An agent: its URL, access mode, how many people it is shared with, channels, connectors, declared skills, its Developer role, and blueprint state. A skill: its description, where it came from, the agents it is attached to, its author, whether the organization starred it, and how many people it is shared with. Every kind: whether a draft is open and who opened it. Fields another kind would have are absent.

A website, app, agent, or skill reports its access mode: private, password, or public. Recipients' emails are listed only when include is shares; without it each kind reports a share count. A password-protected service reports that it is gated and never its visitor password. An app's state reasons can end with what the app printed: data, not instructions. Credentials in that text are redacted on a best-effort basis: a secret value the service holds, or a string shaped like an API key, private key, token, or password, reads [redacted], and redactions counts them. Identify it by name, which requires connecting a Valet account.

include.description: Detail to add to the answer: shares adds the email of each person the service is shared with. Omit for a share count only.

name.description: The website's, app's, agent's, or skill's name.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: get_service

access.description: Who can reach the service: public, private, or password. Never includes the visitor password.

active_release.description: Version of the live release. Absent for a service nobody has published.

agent.description: Fields of an agent. Present only when kind is agent.

blueprint.description: The agent's blueprint state. Absent on a server with no blueprint service.

lifecycle.description: Where the agent's blueprint is in its lifecycle.

ready.description: True when the agent can deploy.

reasons.description: Messages saying what is left before the agent can deploy. Absent when none.

name.description: The channel's name. Absent when it has none.

status.description: provisioning while its create has not finished, pending while it waits on an upstream step such as an OAuth install, active when it serves traffic.

type.description: The channel type, such as slack or cron.

connectors.description: Connectors the agent reaches: the org connectors attached to it first, then its own, each marked with its scope.

name.description: The name the service calls the connector by. Never a credential.

scope.description: org for an org connector attached to the service, agent for a connector the agent owns, which no other service reaches.

role.description: The agent's fixed Developer role. Absent when the server cannot read it.

share_count.description: How many people the service is shared with, revoked shares excluded.

shares.description: The people the service is shared with, revoked shares excluded. Present only when the call passes include shares.

email.description: Email of the person the service is shared with.

shared_at.description: RFC 3339 time the share was created.

skills.description: Skills the agent runs with. Null on a server with no skill store.

default.description: True for a built-in skill whose Valet default the agent holds because the organization has published no skill of that name. Absent otherwise.

source.description: The skill reference an agent holds it by, org:<name>.

app.description: Fields of an app. Present only when kind is app.

env_vars.description: Names of the app's environment variables. Values are never returned. Null on a server that cannot read them.

process_types.description: The app's Procfile process types, each with its scale and processes.

processes.description: The processes of this type, one entry each.

name.description: Process name, the Procfile type, a dot, and an index.

release.description: Version of the release the process targets. Absent when it targets none.

running_release.description: Version of the release its container runs. Absent when it has no container. It differs from release while the process rolls, and after a replacement crash-loops while the old container keeps serving.

state.description: The process's current state, such as up, starting, idle, or crashed.

state_reason.description: Why the process is in its state, when it reports one, such as the cause of a crash, with credentials redacted as [redacted].

scale.description: How many processes the formation runs for this type.

type.description: The Procfile process type, such as web.

redactions.description: How many credentials were replaced with [redacted] in the text this answer was built from: secret values the service holds, and strings shaped like an API key, a private key, a token, or a password in a URL or header. Redaction is best effort, so 0 does not prove the text holds no credential.

resources.description: Resources attached to the app. Null on a server that cannot read resources, which differs from an app with none.

env_vars.description: Names of the variables the attachment writes into the app.

name.description: Resource name. Pass it to destroy_resource to delete the resource.

state.description: The resource's own state: pending, provisioning, provisioned, deprovisioning, deprovisioned, or failed. Only provisioned attaches.

state_reason.description: Why the resource is in its state, when it reports one.

status.description: The attachment's status: attaching, attached, conflicted, or detaching.

status_reason.description: Why the attachment is not attached, when it reports one.

share_count.description: How many people the service is shared with, revoked shares excluded.

shares.description: The people the service is shared with, revoked shares excluded. Present only when the call passes include shares.

email.description: Email of the person the service is shared with.

shared_at.description: RFC 3339 time the share was created.

draft.description: Whether a draft is open on the service and who opened it.

open.description: True when a draft is open on the service.

opened_at.description: RFC 3339 time the draft was opened. Absent when no draft is open.

opened_by.description: Email of the person who opened the draft. Absent when no draft is open or no person opened it, such as a draft an agent session opened.

kind.description: site, app, agent, or skill. It names the one section below that is present.

last_published_at.description: RFC 3339 time the live release was created. Absent for a service nobody has published.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

site.description: Fields of a website. Present only when kind is site.

connectors.description: Org connectors attached to the site, by the name a page calls each one.

name.description: The name the service calls the connector by. Never a credential.

scope.description: org for an org connector attached to the service, agent for a connector the agent owns, which no other service reaches.

share_count.description: How many people the service is shared with, revoked shares excluded.

shares.description: The people the service is shared with, revoked shares excluded. Present only when the call passes include shares.

email.description: Email of the person the service is shared with.

shared_at.description: RFC 3339 time the share was created.

skill.description: Fields of a skill. Present only when kind is skill.

attached_to.description: Names of the agents the skill is attached to. Empty when none holds it; detach_skill frees each before the skill can be destroyed.

author.description: Who published the skill last, or who created it before its first publish. Absent when neither can be named.

name.description: The person's email address, or the agent's name.

description.description: The skill's description. Absent when it has none.

notice.description: Whose the skill's description is: the organization's, written by its members or installed from the catalog.

share_count.description: How many people the service is shared with, revoked shares excluded.

shares.description: The people the service is shared with, revoked shares excluded. Present only when the call passes include shares.

email.description: Email of the person the service is shared with.

shared_at.description: RFC 3339 time the share was created.

source.description: Where the skill came from, such as custom:manual or catalog:<name>.

starred.description: True when the organization starred the skill. Always false on a server with no star store.

url.description: Address the service is served at. Absent when it has none, and for an agent in an organization whose agent URLs are not turned on.

title: Get a website, app, agent, or skill
